description: An addon for Better Than Wolves 3.X. Makes the mod harder and reduces farming tedium. NM features extreme difficulty, new mobs, reworked core mechanics and overhauled bosses. Most mobs gain powerful abilities as world progression increases.

releases.notes: # ☁️The Calm before the Storm **v1.1.6 is finally here** 🎉, and with it comes an update to **BTW CE 3.1.1** released just yesterday! Have fun with the new BTW features # ❓ Where has NM been? Since the last update was 2 months ago, I feel like it's important to address what happened. NM hasn't gone anywhere XD, I have just been incredibly busy, and within the next few weeks I will release a **brand new project** I've been working on. Also, a lot of progress behind the scenes has happened on the **Underworld Update**, and I'm excited to share it all. Since my side-project is close to being finished, a LOT more of my time will go into the Underworld and you can expect the next major update to be **by the end of 2026** 🖤 A tremendous thanks to my lovely patrons, who make this all possible. If you want to show your support for projects like this, the best way to do it is **playing the mod, being a part of the community, or supporting me directly on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/elmi2305/membership)**. ### A huge thanks to my Patreon members: - ❤ **Swirft** - 🧡 **ThornOfTheRose** - 💛 **Crimson Monarch** - 💜 **PirateBananaRamaN1** - 🖤 **Cassie** ## 📃FULL CHANGELOG for v1.1.6: ### 🎮 Gameplay - updated to BTW CE 3.1.1! - reworked the zombie variant system: improving handling, rendering, and future variant additions (thanks shiroinfinity for coding this) - pigmen wielding swords now have increased melee reach (jibanyanc) - prevented arrows from being duplicated by firing them with an infinity-enchanted bow & smelting them in a crucible - Blood Moons now synchronize correctly in multiplayer: all online players must drink a Crimson Bottle within a short window to trigger one (jibanyanc) - portal grace period lowered in Real Time config - RT (Real Time) config now supports crop, hemp, and sapling growth using elapsed world time. its unlock requirement has also been adjusted to be defeating the wither - dragon vessels now hold up to 100,000 XP, retain overflow from large XP orbs, can eject more XP when broken, and accept XP from hoppers faster - nether mob spawners have much higher explosion resistance (thepiratebananaraman1) - reduced sticky creeper spawnrate (thepiratebananaraman1) - Blood Ingot Blocks and Refined Diamond blocks now mine properly with diamond pickaxes - reverted the removal of vine trap recipes & restored carpet recipes - updated sign recipe handling for multiplayer (thepiratebananaraman1) - adjusted achievement layout (fixing an overlap and weird achievement placement) - reverted the lowered respawn distance back to BTW's standard ### 🔨 Fixes - fixed an EntityAILunge null-pointer crash on servers (ITL Supress) - fixed: blood armor achievement correctly appears without requiring the blood sword to be held - updated the game window title and added the Nightmare Mode window icon (experimental, let me know if you don't like it) - added contributor and mixin-development documentation for the project! contributors are welcome, contact me if you wish to help out - added emi info for blood ingot blocks & refined diamond blocks, describing what they do - fixed: spider eye drop rates are increased correctly (ron) - fixed: obsidian fish are no longer dupable by silk-touch mining obsidian (thepiratebananaraman1) - fixed: endermen only drop eyes of ender after the dragon has been defeated (config edge cases) (Galx_pl & ron) - fixed: brown mushroom trees correctly drop brown mushrooms after hardmode (galx_pl) - fixed: some eclipse enemies could drop eclipse shards bypassing the player-kill requirement - fixed: eclipse skeletons now correctly run from the player (galx_pl) ## 🧵 FULL NM FEATURE LIST (all the way up to v1.1.6): [Nightmare Mode FULL Changelog.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32074637/Nightmare.Mode.FULL.Changelog.txt) ## 📚 The Wiki ...

releases.notes: # 🔧 Various critical fixes and improvements for v1.1.5, along with a little something special **v1.1.5** had a bunch of bugs on release. This patch merely fixes them, thus I'm calling it **v1.1.5a**. Considering how small this release is, the entire changelog fits in this post! Considering how tiny this release is, the entire changelog is small enough to show on this page 🎉 Thanks to all the people that reported these bugs, pretty much immediately after the release was published. # v1.1.5a Changelog ## 🛠️ Fixes: - diamond tools are now repairable with refined diamonds as well (thepiratebananaraman1) - removed BW debug from 1.1.5, fixing the entire fight - fixed issue with certain spiders not being able to despawn - fixed event packets being sent when no players are on the server - blood moon music no longer crashes the server - bloodwither music no longer crashes the server - blood zombies spawn correctly - active music stops when the player dies, since previously it would continue playing in the main menu if you left the world - fixed event text appearing multiple times in chat, when the event starts and when it ends (galx_pl) - nether gloom now dynamically updates. if the 3 day grace period runs out in the nether, the lightmap will reload and gloom will function properly, instead of only getting gloomed when the player re-enters the dimension - teleporting through portals happens instantly in creative mode, like vanilla - fixed event chat text crashing on servers - fixed various saving issues pertaining to the underworld dimension not registering a crucial nbt file correctly. this is most prominently visible with beacons (thanks dravigen) - fixed ladder achievement being unobtainable, and post-wither bloodmoon achievement mistakenly being post-dragon (galx_pl) - fixed NM's achievements only triggering in the overworld. they can now trigger in any dimension (galx_pl) - fixed various issues with baby zombies, their height, their hitbox, and relogging rerolling their chance to become a baby - fixed bloodmoon helper GUI height. previously it added an extra line of space if it was enabled but the world was not in hardmode - fixed configs being completeable on custom-built superflat worlds (Angelein20) - fixed issues with spider and hell event permanently ruining the spawn table of chunks generated while it is active - fixed horse packets being sent when not necessary, and crashing the client in multiplayer servers (#20 on github) - fixed magma cubes shooting the wrong projectile in the overworld, noticable during the hell event (jibanyanc) - fixed rain lasting longer than it should - fixed various things about the day of reckoning... - fixed book recipe: it's now craftable via tag, so both leather types are clearly visible to the player (jibanyanc) - fixed hardmode exclusive jungle spiders not spawning in the EvolvedMobs config (galx_pl) - fixed wither damage cap and death behavior ## ⚔️ Gameplay Changes: - lowered the exclusion radius of mob spawns during a blood moonfrom 8 blocks to 5 blocks - villagers can additionally be lured by holding a refined diamond ingot - villagers additionally use refined diamond ingots as a breeding item - spider aggro radius increases with world progress - new block: Blood Ingot Block. crafted with 9 blood ingots, it's a cool looking decoration block. it can be used to create a beacon, which grants strength I-IV depending on level - new block: Refined Diamond Block. crafted with 9 refined diamond ingots. it's a cool looking decoration block. it can be used to create a beacon, which grants speed I-IV depending on level - the day of reckoning now additionally spawns wither skeletons and regular overworld mobs ## 🖥️ UI & User Experience improvements: - added russian translations, made by shiroinfinity ...

releases.notes: # 🎉✨ Bug fixes, new Mobs and TWO YEARS ON GITHUB 🎉✨ A relatively small update from v1.1.4 that fixes many of its bugs, adds some new content, and introduces features to support the ongoing **Multiplayer** and **NM Config Mode** efforts within the community. > Screenshot taken by giohappy Today marks the 2 year anniversary of this github project. NM originally started development around june 15th of 2024, but the github repository was created june 26th. It makes me really happy seeing how far this project has come. Hopefully I'll be able to develop it even further throughout college. Now for the changelog: ### 🍄 Mob Related Features: - **Mush Worms** have been completely reworked: * only spawn from Red Mushrooms * no longer spread into regular Silverfish * can no longer be used for clay or XP farms * no longer appear in excessive numbers from giant mushrooms - Added four new **More Variants** exclusive mobs: * **Glitch Creeper**: kicks the player from their world after exploding. harmless * **Sticky Creeper**: very low health, causes the player to drop their held item when hit * **Void Creeper**: creates a Black Hole on death. it pulls entities in and then explodes * **Lightning Skeleton**: fragile but fires lightning arrows, spawning more frequently during storms - **Tooled Mobs** will now leap toward players standing on unreachable terrain, making towering and high-ground strategies far less reliable - **Creepers** now intelligently decide when to jump, allowing them to better punish players camping above them while avoiding pointless jumps when the player is below - **Skeleton variants now properly use their intended stats.** this is mostly a buff ### ⚔️ Gameplay Changes: - added **Random Events**, bringing occasional special days with unique gameplay and effects - **Mobs now drop more XP as the world progresses** - enchanting costs roughly **30% less XP** on the regular enchantment table - **The Wither** drops substantially more XP the first time it is killed - added crafting recipes to empty **Planters** and **Potions**, returning the empty container - Zombies break blocks significantly faster during Blood Moons - added a new immersive vignette effect during dangerous situations such as Blood Moons, boss fights, darkness and caving - **various damage sources now bypass armor and additionally drain hunger**, making environmental hazards and certain enemies more threatening. don't hug the saw ### 🖥️ UI & User Experience: - added a bunch of **EMI integration**, including: * item and block descriptions * food values * Eclipse Item category * changed EMI entries for existing BTW / Vanilla blocks / items to reflect their use in NM - added custom audio for major events such as **Blood Moons** and **the Bloodwither fight**. massive shoutout to @heyitsjd3 on discord for the sound design - reverted Blood Moon visuals to the old style after community feedback, updated sky and weather effects - added creative-mode utilities for equipping mobs with armor and weapons for testing - reorganized config difficulty ranking after community feedback ### 🤝 Multiplayer: - added configurable **Grief Logging**, allowing server owners to record actions such as destroying containers, igniting TNT and other potentially destructive player activity. is that a grief reference?! - added support for multiplayer-exclusive recipes - signs are now significantly easier to craft on multiplayer servers - fixed several multiplayer issues, including horse armor crashes and improved synchronization of world events ### 🛠️ Fixes - fixed a bug that would allow eclipse zombies to summon thousands of jungle spiders & silverfish when killed automatically (piratebananaraman1) - fixed mobs incorrectly dropping leather and wool armor (finally) ...

releases.notes: # Fixes, utilities, mushrooms and a Happy Birthday to the developer 🎉 ### Image made by **Flameheart** ## **Nightmare Mode Iceberg** ### How many things do you recognize? # HEADLINE CHANGES This version was partly a maintenance release, but also did a lot of things from the ground up and polished many aspects of the mod. You can just look at the file size, down from like 14mb to just 8. It's small enough to be sent as a **Discord attachment** 🥳 ## HEADLINE CHANGES: - ### **Increased the dangers of mushroom islands** - Made Mooshrooms much stronger and unmilkable - New Hostile Mob: **Mush Worm**. Spawns on mushroom islands, behaves like a regular silverfish, infests mushroom blocks and spawns a cloud of poison when killed. - **Mycelium no longer blocks mob spawning** - **Brown Mushrooms as a resource have been moved to Hardmode**, meaning any recipes that include them are also hardmode-exclusive - ### **Tweaked Nether Mobs** - **Ghasts** fire slower (+3 ticks) and have **smaller explosions** pre-Hardmode - **Pigmen** attack players wearing Gold Armor. The armor only reduces their aggro range - ### **Early Game Tweaks** - **Crops (raw & cooked) heal way less food (LeonTalksALot)** - **Flint n Steel** is now post-crafting table, requiring **2 Flint and 3 nuggets** to make - **Zombie's digging speed** increases the more time it spends breaking blocks. It calms down naturally over time - ### **New GUI Features** - Added a Create New World button in the main menu that immediately puts you in a new world. the settings for these worlds can be adjusted in the world info menu, accessible by pressing the gear icon. - Added the ability to **Favorite ⭐** worlds, so they always show up at the top of your list **Read the full changelog here:** [1.1.4 changelog.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28165207/1.1.4.changelog.txt) ## **FULL CHANGELOG FOR NM:** [Nightmare Mode FULL Changelog.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28165551/Nightmare.Mode.FULL.Changelog.txt) ## The Wiki Nightmare Mode has a community made Wiki! It's open to contribution! Help document Nightmare Mode features, strategies, or anything else that you think might be relevant for players! [**[Wiki Page]**](https://btwnm.wiki.gg/) # Special Thanks The support has been AMAZING lately. I couldn't be more thankful, especially since we got two new members for my birthday! I'm delighted to announce our lovely [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/elmi2305/membership) supporters: - 🟣 **PirateBananaRamaN1** - everyone knows pirate! A long time member, contributor and helper - 🔴 **Swirft** - another person who wishes to not be named, as they don't seem to be in the NM Discord Server - 🟢 **Calebrune3** - 🟤 **Crimson Monarch** - ⚪ **ThornOfTheRose** - ⚫ **valka7** ## Thank you for playing 🖤 ## Join us in the **NM Discord Server: https://discord.gg/3Ws8bCp3T6**

releases.notes: ### Huge performance improvements, bugfixes and yet another maintenance update! # **Changelog for v1.1.3:** - **Fixed**: Blood Bone Blocks are now obtainable via the creative menu (thanks Flameheart) - **Fixed**: Bandages can no longer stack to 16 - **Fixed**: Magic Arrows now correctly render with their own custom texture, & fixed client-side entity reflection - Reimplemented Skeleton behavior to **melee-attack** nearby players. this was an attempt to fix common exploits involving getting too close to the skeleton, causing its arrow projectile to ignore the player - Refactored every Creeper variant, with **noticeable performance** improvements to each Creeper. this includes potential changes in their explosion strength that were previously unaccounted for (eg. Fire Creeper explosions were weaker than explosions of regular Creepers - they are now equal) - **Fixed**: Snow Golem snowballs properly affect players - Snowballs now affect players (including the player who threw them). this means snowballs can be used on other players in Multiplayer - **Fixed**: Chain Armor crucible recipes returned 25% instead of 33% of the iron (thanks ThePirateBananaRamaN1) - **Fixed**: Steel Ore can no longer be harvested by Creeper explosions (thanks smiley) - Snow Golems now attack all hostile mobs. the knockback effect of snowballs can be used to pull mobs in automatically - **Fixed**: Vessel of the Dragon trade was mistakenly not overridden for many updates. It is now an Ocular of Ender (thanks MKIncendio) - Changed the recipe of maps: they no longer require soul urns (thanks Aristokrat) - Changed Blood Orb texture (thanks jespacito) - Large performance improvements through fixing old code Going through old code, I realized just how many mistakes I had made years ago that compounded into a huge performance overhead. The game should perform much better now! **FULL NM CHANGELOG:** [Nightmare Mode FULL Changelog.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26453738/Nightmare.Mode.FULL.Changelog.txt) # **v1.1.3-3.1.0-port** - **Fixed:** Blazes can no longer lunge at players outside their aggro radius - **Fixed:** Lightning Creepers can no longer spawn inside walls - Skeleton Melee & Ranged attack share the same cooldown. Their melee attack previously could combo into their ranged attack and felt too strong - **Fixed:** Zombies can no longer get stuck breaking leaves. This allowed for some exploits around trees - **Fixed:** Hostile Mob regeneration cooldown is properly reset when the mob is hit. Previously they'd heal while in combat, effectively giving them 1-3 more HP - Temporarily removed the Loom recipe, as I will rework it later in development - **Ported NM to BTW CE 3.1.0** # Additionally, NM Now has a community managed **Wiki**! ### **Check it out [HERE](https://btwnm.wiki.gg/)** **Thanks to Flameheart for creating and adding basic information! It will be updated to have much more content over time** # Another Special Thanks Even though I've been on break for a while (classes, exams, graduation thesis), the support I've had on **Patreon** has been insane! Another MASSIVE thanks to all of my Patrons: - **Calebrune3** - **valka7** - **ThornOfTheRose** - **Crimson Monarch** **Thanks to all the support, I've been able to work through exams and provide a release that should fix a lot of issues v1.1.2 and v1.1.2a had! I'm insanely lucky to be here.** **If you wish to support, here is my [**Patreon**](https://www.patreon.com/c/elmi2305)** # **Thanks for playing** 🖤 ...
